---
title: SciStor
---

SciStor is basic storage hosted on the VU campus. Access is via a "mount" (drive letter). SciStor is also suited for data output of  lab instruments and high-performance computing (HPC/ADA).

[More info](/tools/yoda/index.qmd)

::: {.table header-rows=0}
|  |  | 
| --- | --- |
| **Max. storage size** | Terabytes of data |
| **Costs** | You pay for the amount of space allocated to your project folder: €0,16 per GB per year. |
| **Sharing and collaboration** | VU employees and students only |
| **Location** | VU Campus (NL) |
| **File recovery** | Via [snapshots](/tools/scistor/snapshots-data-recovery.qmd) |
| **Data classification** | High |
:::
